literal_meaning: ধুম-ধাম করে শব্দ করে মারধর (অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ)
figurative_meaning_en: to beat or thrash someone vigorously with hands
similar_in_english: beat the living daylights out of
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে রাগের মাথায় ধুমধাড়াক্কা করে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He beat him up in a fit of rage with dhummdharaakkaa.
The kids played rough, giving each other a dhummdharaakkaa.
note: Onomatopoeic expression mimicking the sound of vigorous beating
